acceptance_criteria.condition: V6 new Skill snapshot is byte-identical to SKILL.md and preregistration binds all frozen inputs.
All three conditions run with automatic Skill search disabled; treatment provenance records API-key mode and CLI version.
Untracked allowed and disallowed files are captured in candidate.diff and independently replayed.
Full package tests, type checks, compilation, Skill validation, and diff hygiene pass before collection.
acceptance_criteria.verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests; pytest -q; basedpyright --level error <V6 files>

affected_callers: V6 blind scorer and replay analyzer
repository maintainers running the frozen checks

documentation_synchronization.evidence: README and preregistration state API-key execution limits and scoped claim.

independent_review.notes: Review confirms API-key/Skill-search isolation, provenance, replay, and scoped README claims after current focused suite passes.

instrumentation.cardinality_review: Task and condition values are fixed by the manifest.

events.redaction_review: No API key, prompt payload, or personal data is recorded.

instrumentation.evidence: Focused protocol tests assert provenance, sequencing, and replay gates.
instrumentation.threshold_and_action: Any missing provenance or replay mismatch makes collection ineligible.

invariants: Only the preregistered API-key Codex CLI executor may produce eligible V6 trials.
No condition may receive automatic Skill discovery; only old/new receive their frozen policy snapshot.
Hidden tests and reference fixes remain unavailable until after agent exit; scorer replay must match recorded semantics.
Any incomplete, tampered, out-of-scope, or replay-divergent collection is ineligible; no selective retry.
The result can support only the fixed model, CLI Harness, Skill snapshots, corpus, and scorer scope.

remaining_risks: Native CLI execution is protocol/workspace isolated rather than cryptographically attested container isolation.
API service availability or rate limiting can make the fixed collection ineligible; failures must be retained, not retried selectively.
Even an eligible collection cannot prove model-wide causal reasoning or production reliability.

remove: placeholder snapshot text and stale V6 executor wording

rollback_or_compatibility: Revert the V6 executor, protocol scripts, snapshots, README, tests, evidence, and manifest together. Preserve V4/V5 invalidation archives byte-for-byte; do not convert an interrupted or invalid collection into an effect claim.

safeguards.name: API-key preflight and redaction
safeguards.rationale: The collector verifies non-secret auth status and redacts token-shaped text from transcripts.

safeguards.name: Skill-search isolation
safeguards.rationale: Every Codex invocation includes --disable skill_search and --ignore-user-config.

safeguards.name: Blind post-exit scoring
safeguards.rationale: Hidden tests are injected only after agent exit and candidate diffs are replayed independently.
